original_test_intent: Soak the exact BlueField Ethernet data path against a compatible peer for eight hours and prove sustained bandwidth remains within the approved specification without link, system or thermal faults.
original_method: Pin a supported iperf version/protocol/profile; map dedicated BDF/netdev/physical port/peer and isolate traffic; define numeric throughput/interval/drop/retransmit oracle; capture baseline; run server and client for 28,800 seconds with 60-second samples; monitor counters, logs and telemetry; stop on limits; clean up and compare full trace.
manual_activity: Network owner supplies peer/profile/SPEC and approves saturation window; operator ensures isolation and recovery; agent may run and monitor the exact approved soak.
required_inputs: Pinned iperf2/iperf3 artifact/version/checksum and matching peer
Client/server roles, protocol, streams, direction, buffer/window and bind settings
Maintenance isolation, telemetry, abort and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: Do not download an arbitrary latest binary
Do not substitute RDMA tools without new approval
Preserve complete interval and system logs
Stop on throughput/error/link/thermal/access threshold; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and launch exact peer roles
Monitor full eight-hour telemetry and enforce stops
Clean up and report raw evidence without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its high-level soak concept fits, but iperf, mlnx_perf and ib_write_bw are not interchangeable and it omits the source's exact 28,800-second iperf run.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use pinned matching iperf endpoints with explicit bind/profile and full 28,800-second duration, retaining 60-second interval output and concurrent link/system telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SUT server, peer client, 60-second reporting, 28,800-second duration, attended 30 and machine 500 minutes are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a reproducible interface-bound iperf soak with periodic throughput/error samples, independent health telemetry and bounded abort/cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Pins provenance/profile, defines numeric oracle and adds isolation/monitoring/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An RDMA benchmark or final-only aggregate cannot replace eight-hour Ethernet interval behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Saturation can impact shared fabric and thermal state; peer CPU/path may bottleneck observed throughput.

project_override_considerations: Owner must choose iperf2 versus iperf3, TCP/UDP, streams/directions, port binding, warmup, expected line-rate efficiency and interval/final statistic rules.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek retains the Ethernet long-soak intent; its broad alternative list is narrowed to the source-specific iperf method rather than treated as a different testcase.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if compatible peer/dedicated path, exact iperf profile, numeric SPEC, monitoring/abort or recovery cannot be established.

review_improvement: Turns a generic saturation note into a source-faithful, reproducible Ethernet endurance measurement with interval-level health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: iperf and RDMA tools exercise different protocol stacks, so tool substitution would change coverage. Sustained bandwidth also cannot be proven by a final number alone; the 60-second trace must be correlated with link counters and system health across the full eight hours.
